description: Load an EVM contract's ABI like a block explorer's Contract tab: Sourcify first, then Etherscan (when configured), else pass abi. Follows EIP-1967 proxies (shows the implementation's functions, calls still go to the proxy). Returns read (view/pure) and write functions with signatures, selectors, inputs, outputs and payable flags, plus warnings (third-party ABI, proxy, no code). Read-only. Powered by blocktools (ABI coding). How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

abi.description: Optional ABI JSON to use instead of the Sourcify / Etherscan lookup (labelled as pasted; not checked against source).

chainId.description: EVM chain id or name (1 eth, 8453 base, 42161 arbitrum, 10 optimism, 137 polygon, 56 bnb, 43114 avalanche, 59144 linea, 534352 scroll).
